name: unown-nonllm-testbench
description: Non-LLM hypothesis testbench for Unown's learning layer: local ONNX encoders (bge-small / MiniLM / ms-marco cross-encoder) via transformers.js + onnxruntime-node, plus zero-model symbolic lanes (MinHash-LSH, LexRank, activation scoring). Isolated deps on purpose: the repo itself stays native-addon-free; this bench owns its node_modules.
